system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: PalmClaw assembles the agent context from six sources: 1) system instructions fromAGENT.md, SOUL.md, and USER.md; 2) runtime context, including the current time, timezone, session ID, and workspace paths
system_prompt_style.note: Skills selected per turn; context rebuilt each round.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Workspace access uses nine focused file tools over `WorkspaceFileSystem`.
env_context_strategy.note: Runtime context also injects workspace paths; no file tree injection evidenced.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: When unconsolidated messages reach a configurable window, a separate LLM call summa-rizes older messages and updates both layers.
context_compaction.note: tool_output_pruning from 'stores bounded results' in architecture.md.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Tools | Validate schemas, enforce bounds, execute capabilities, and return structured results.
observation_format.note: Exact serialization to model not in evidence.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: The first five sources form the model messages, while the tool specifications are provided alongside them to the remote LLM API.
tool_call_format.note: ToolCallParser.kt exists but content not in evidence.

tool_count.note: Tool registry files listed but contents not in evidence; Figure 3 lists ~20 tool groups.

edit_primitive.note: edit() tool listed in Fig. 3; semantics of edit inferred.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: MCP connection, capability discovery, dynamic tool publication, content access, retries, and shutdown are owned by `McpRuntimeLifecycle`.
tool_schema_source.note: hand_written inferred from Kotlin tool definitions; not verified.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Use built-in or custom LLM providers, MCP servers, and bundled or installed skills.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: If the response contains tool calls, PalmClaw executes them, appends their results to the session, and starts the next round with the updated context.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Skills are reusable task instructions for apply-ing tools and completing common routines, stored in SKILL.md files.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: `AgentLoop` persists the incoming message, selects skills, builds model context, calls the provider, executes validated tool calls, stores bounded results, and repeats until completion or cancellation.
multi_agent_topology.note: SpawnTool.kt and SubagentManager.kt exist; default exposure unverified.

delegation_mechanism.note: Inferred from file names SpawnTool.kt/SubagentManager.kt only.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Every tool must preserve typed schemas, Android permissions, confirmation for risky operations, explicit timeouts, structured errors, operation bounds, and post-mutation verification where applicable.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Each session stores its conversation history, tool traces, attachments, and a dedicated workspace for documents, temporary files, and generated arti-facts.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: PalmClaw maintains two persistent mem-orylayers: 1)sharedlong-termmemory, whichstores information available across sessions and is included in each agent’s turn
long_term_memory.note: MEMORY.md template; skills in SKILL.md with ClawHub install.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Keep long-task progress, pause, resume, and trace work outside the current stage.
state_persistence.note: Sessions persist history across turns, but mid-turn resume is explicitly deferred.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Reconsider progress, compact trace, retry, recovery, pause, and resume after the current system boundaries remain stable.
self_verification.note: Tool-level post-mutation verification exists but no harness verification of agent output.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Reconsider progress, compact trace, retry, recovery, pause, and resume after the current system boundaries remain stable.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The loop also ends when a tool signals task completion or the round limit is reached.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Every tool must preserve typed schemas, Android permissions, confirmation for risky operations, explicit timeouts

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: It keeps sessions, context management, memory, skills, tools, and the agent loop on the device
execution_isolation.note: In-app on Android; Android app sandbox applies; no shell.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Paths remain within approved workspace roots, traversal does not follow links by default

network_policy.evidence_quote: MCP uses HTTPS by default. Local HTTP is allowed; private-LAN HTTP requires explicit origin approval and cannot carry a Bearer token.
network_policy.note: Web tools unrestricted; MCP URL policy only.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Before the corresponding operation is executed, the callpassesthreechecks: 1)Schemavalidatesrequired arguments, types, and allowed ranges. 2)Permissions includes device authorization and user confirmation.
permission_model.note: Rule-based per-tool checks plus confirmation for risky ops; closest value.

tracing.evidence_quote: Keep conversation history, tool traces, attachments, session workspaces, and reusable memory across turns.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: A benchmark, demo, or generated trace alone is not source verification.
eval_hooks.note: No eval runner in file tree; paper evaluation external.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Check schemas, Android permissions, user confirmations, and workspace paths before device actions are executed.

target_domain.evidence_quote: An AI agent framework that runs natively on your Android phone.
